input.code:
from statistics import median

shape = await tools.read_count_component(component="shape")
ptr = await tools.read_count_component(component="indptr")
data = await tools.read_count_component(component="data")
meta = await tools.read_dataset_record()
values = data["values"]
boundaries = ptr["values"]
totals = [sum(values[a:b]) for a, b in zip(boundaries[:-1], boundaries[1:])]
print({"cells": shape["values"][1], "median_counts": float(median(totals)),
       "total_counts": sum(totals), "source": meta["doi"]})
